0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>Vishrahd is looking at you impatiently.

48.original: You must be the substitute hamsa-keeper. Well, you're late! Feeding time was supposed to start bells ago! And a hungry hamsa is a noisy hamsa, as you can hear for yourself.

49.original: What're you standing around for? Are you going to leave those poor creatures to starve to death? Get to work! Chop-chop!

50.original: Here you go─one large feed bag, and one small. Hamsa of different stature have different diets, you see. And they're finicky eaters, to boot.

51.original: The smaller ones require only a simple mix of greens and grains. But our big boys also need a helping of silkworm pupae for extra protein. The foodstuffs are next to that wooden crate over there. Now get to it!

52.original: How many times do I have to explain it? The smaller hamsa only get greens and grains. The larger hamsa get silkworms as well. The foodstuffs are over there by the crate. Now, chop-chop!

53.original: Which bag will you scoop the grain into?

57.original: Which bag will you scoop the silkworms into?

61.original: Which bag will you scoop the vegetable scraps into?

65.original: Dispose of the feed bag's contents?

68.original: Keep the bags as they are.

69.original: Are you sure you wish to discard the contents of your feed bag?

70.original: That particular food is already in your feed bag.

71.original: You unceremoniously heap feed into your bag.

72.original: The hamsa flaps its wings and its eyes light up with gastronomic delight!

73.original: The hamsa shuns the bag and stares blankly skyward as if forsaken by the gods. Perhaps the feed mix is wrong?

74.original: The hamsa stares off happily into space, its belly sated.

75.original: The hamsa is eyeing you expectantly...

76.original: Done already? Perhaps you're not as hopeless as you look. But you'd better be on time for the next feeding. Er, what was your name again?

77.original: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>? Wait, you don't mean... <hex:021A020203>That<hex:021A020103> <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>!? The adventurer who rescued Matsya from the beasts!?

78.original: My most sincere apologies! I never imagined a hero like you would simply be walking amongst us...and slopping the hamsa, besides! Heavens, my face must be so red right now...

79.original: Anyhow, er...I thank you for a job well done. Here's your pay for today's work. Now, I'd best hunt down the <hex:021A020203>real<hex:021A020103> substitute hamsa-keeper.
